decisions.reason: Novel law enforcement action: Coast Guard and FBI boarded two foreign tankers in the Gulf of Mexico to investigate suspected cyber intrusions. Real operational event, not a policy piece.
Major vendor patch cycle: Oracle September 2026 CPU covers 673 vulns, 104 critical. E-Business Suite alone gets 159 patches. Significant for enterprise defenders.
Novel attack technique: GhostCode device-code phishing kit exploits Entra device enrollment to persist after token revocation. Real threat research with defensive implications.
Additional reporting on N0va SSO hijacking campaign. Builds on existing story coverage.
Issabel PBX CVE-2026-89026 (CVSS 9.3): hardcoded JWT key enables unauthenticated RCE via Asterisk Manager Interface. Actively exploited in the wild.

CVE-2026-89026.evidence: Event states the vulnerability is 'exploited in active attacks'. Hardcoded signing key allows forged JWT tokens to trigger arbitrary command execution on vulnerable PBX deployments.

decisions.reason: German-language coverage of Chrome 42-vuln security update. Same Chrome update already covered in the main story; this is an additional outlet.
Additional coverage of actively exploited Pixel modem zero-day CVE-2026-58704.
VectraRAT MaaS platform: purpose-built RAT with automated credential theft and silent UAC bypass. Novel malware platform, not recycled commodity code.
SecurityWeek's detailed write-up of CVE-2026-58704: modem-level zero-click permission bypass, targeted exploitation likely linked to commercial spyware or state actors.

CVE-2026-58704.evidence: Google confirmed 'limited, targeted exploitation'. Modem-level, zero-click flaw rated high severity. Hallmarks of commercial spyware or state-sponsored attacks.

decisions.reason: TP-Link Tapo camera CVE-2026-15316: admin access without authentication plus denial-of-service against onboarding flow. IoT vuln with active exploitation.
OEMpocalypse Now: zero-permission Android apps gain root by targeting flawed manufacturer code. Novel Android attack surface research.
Parallels Mac local privilege escalation: trust in peer credentials plus quoted folder name allows any local user to root the box.
CISA advisory: critical ScreenConnect flaw actively exploited in attacks. Adds official confirmation to existing story.
Additional coverage of Cisco Secure Email Gateway zero-day CVE-2026-76461 exploited to execute commands as root.
